details.jobDescription:
The Security and Safety Department is a unit of the Global Security Operations Management function. The department's main activity is to protect people, property, assets, and information by reducing the risk to the business.

We are currently seeking a dedicated Security Officer to oversee and manage our comprehensive security operations.

Responsabilities:

  • Physical Security Management: The Security Officer will oversee all aspects of our physical security infrastructure, including the access control system, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV), and coordination of the security guard team to ensure a safe and secure environment within company.

  • Travel Security: Implement and manage travel security measures to protect employees during business trips and ensure their safety and security at all times.

  • Business Continuity: The Security Officer will play a crucial role in our business continuity planning, developing strategies to maintain operations and reduce risks during unforeseen events or crises.

  • Employee Credibility: Managing and upholding the integrity and credibility of our employees through thorough checks and continuous oversight will be a key responsibility.

  • Investigation: The role requires conducting and overseeing investigations into any security breaches or incidents, ensuring they are thoroughly resolved and analyzed for future prevention.

  • Vendor and Third-Party Collaboration: The Security Officer will be expected to work closely with external vendors and third parties that are integral to company security infrastructure, ensuring seamless operation and high standards of security.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Effective collaboration with various stakeholders across the company, including Operations, Legal, HR, and Recruitment teams, is essential. The ability to work synergistically across departments to uphold and enhance security measures is a critical aspect of this role.

Knowledge, Experience and Qualifications:

  • Minimum experience of 3 years in the security industry, managing security activities.

  • Proficient in security and safety industry practices is a must, experience in project management – advantage.

  • Strong understanding of security principles and best practices, exhibiting your attention to detail when applying this knowledge to policy development and execution.

  • Experience with Access Control, CCTV, IDS and other physical security systems.

  • Meticulous organization skills, managing multiple tasks and prioritizing effectively to meet deadlines.

  • Pro-active approach and willingness to take the initiative.

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team, ensuring high-quality work delivery in a well-organized manner

  • Excellent English and Romanian written and verbal communication skills, allowing you to articulate complex concepts with precision.

  • Willingness to travel abroad for project-related activities

Benefits:

  • Fixed salary package

  • Meal tickets

  • Private medical insurance

  • Professional development and training opportunities

If you are a proactive, security-minded professional with the skills and experience in the areas outlined above, we would like to invite you to apply for the Security Officer position at Playtika Romania.

Join us in a role where you can truly make a difference in safeguarding our people and our business.
